plain.li: {PAWN_nameDef} sets down {PAWN_possessive} tools and asks for a word.
{PAWN_nameDef} has clearly been working up to this all day.
Over the scrape of shovels and the hiss of the cookfire, {PAWN_nameDef} makes {PAWN_possessive} case.
{PAWN_nameDef} corners whoever happens to be at the stockpile.
It comes up halfway through a conversation about fence posts.
{PAWN_nameDef} has a request, and has rehearsed it, and still fumbles the opening.
Somewhere between one chore and the next, {PAWN_nameDef} stops and says it out loud.
{PAWN_nameDef} leans in the doorway and doesn't move until {PAWN_pronoun}'s been heard.
[morning] {PAWN_nameDef} brings it up over breakfast, between two mouthfuls.
[morning] Before the day's work has properly started, {PAWN_nameDef} has a request.
[morning,winter] Breath steaming in the morning cold, {PAWN_nameDef} clears {PAWN_possessive} throat.
[day] {PAWN_nameDef} wipes {PAWN_possessive} hands on {PAWN_possessive} trousers and walks over with purpose.
[evening] It comes out at supper, once the work is done and the bowls are empty.
[evening] As the light goes amber, {PAWN_nameDef} finally says what's been sitting on {PAWN_possessive} chest all day.
[night] {PAWN_nameDef} can't sleep, and gets up to say what's been keeping {PAWN_objective} awake.
[night] Long after the others have gone to bed, {PAWN_nameDef} is still awake, going over what {PAWN_pronoun} wants to say.
[rain] With the rain drumming on the roof and nowhere to be, {PAWN_nameDef} finally says it.
[rain,!summer] Cold rain sheets past the door. {PAWN_nameDef} watches it for a while, then turns around.
[snow] Stamping snow off {PAWN_possessive} boots, {PAWN_nameDef} decides today is the day to ask.
[snow] Snow is piled against the walls, and after three days indoors {PAWN_nameDef} has had time to think it over.
[storm] Thunder cracks overhead. {PAWN_nameDef} waits for it to roll past, then says what's been on {PAWN_possessive} mind.
[fog] {PAWN_nameDef} comes in out of the fog, damp to the knees, and gets straight to it.
[hot] Wiping sweat out of {PAWN_possessive} eyes, {PAWN_nameDef} stops work long enough to make a point.
[cold,!snow] Hands jammed under {PAWN_possessive} armpits for warmth, {PAWN_nameDef} raises a matter.
[spring] The ground is thawing, and {PAWN_nameDef} has been making plans.
[fall] With the harvest coming in and the evenings getting shorter, {PAWN_nameDef} speaks up.
[lowmood] {PAWN_nameDef} has hardly spoken in days, and when {PAWN_pronoun} does, it's this.
[lowmood] There are dark circles under {PAWN_nameDef}'s eyes when {PAWN_pronoun} comes to ask.
[highmood] In a rare good mood, {PAWN_nameDef} decides to push {PAWN_possessive} luck.
[highmood] {PAWN_nameDef} is humming as {PAWN_pronoun} comes over to ask.
[trait:Abrasive] {PAWN_nameDef} doesn't so much ask as announce.
[trait:Abrasive] {PAWN_nameDef} interrupts someone else's conversation to start this one.
[trait:Kind] {PAWN_nameDef} waits for a free moment, then asks, almost apologetically.
[trait:Greedy] {PAWN_nameDef} has been taking stock of what the others have, and comes with a list.
[trait:Jealous] {PAWN_nameDef} has been keeping count of who got what.
[trait:Psychopath] {PAWN_nameDef} says it in the same flat voice {PAWN_pronoun} uses for the weather.
[trait:Ascetic] {PAWN_nameDef} almost never asks for anything, so people stop to listen.
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] {PAWN_nameDef} asks without putting down {PAWN_possessive} work.
[trait:Bloodlust] {PAWN_nameDef} talks with a knife in one hand and a whetstone in the other.
[trait:Pyromaniac] {PAWN_nameDef} keeps striking sparks off a flint while {PAWN_pronoun} talks.
[trait:Nervous|trait:Volatile] {PAWN_nameDef}'s voice cracks halfway through, but {PAWN_pronoun} gets there.
[old] {PAWN_nameDef} sinks into a chair, knees creaking, and says, "Now listen."
[old] {PAWN_nameDef} has outlived worse than this colony, and is not shy about mentioning it.
[child] {PAWN_nameDef} tugs at the nearest sleeve until someone listens.
[child] {PAWN_nameDef} has drawn a picture of what {PAWN_pronoun} wants, in charcoal, on the wall.
[teen] {PAWN_nameDef} rolls {PAWN_possessive} eyes as if it's no big deal, then asks anyway.
[hurt] Still bandaged, {PAWN_nameDef} limps over to make a request.
[hurt] {PAWN_nameDef} winces when {PAWN_pronoun} sits down, and makes sure the others notice.
[newcomer] Barely unpacked, {PAWN_nameDef} already has opinions about the place.
[afterraid] The smoke from the last attack has barely cleared when {PAWN_nameDef} speaks up.
[afterraid] Someone is still scrubbing blood off the floor when {PAWN_nameDef} comes to talk.
[grieving] Since the funeral, {PAWN_nameDef} hasn't bothered with pleasantries.
[repeat] {PAWN_nameDef} raises the matter again.
[repeat] {PAWN_nameDef} makes the same request as last time, nearly word for word.
[repeat,trait:Abrasive] {PAWN_nameDef} brings it up again, louder this time.
[bitter] {PAWN_nameDef} asks without much hope, already half turned to leave.
[bitter] "I know how this goes," {PAWN_nameDef} says, before asking anyway.
[trusting] {PAWN_nameDef} asks with the easy confidence of someone who's been listened to before.
[doubtful] {PAWN_nameDef} asks, but the tone says {PAWN_pronoun} isn't expecting much.
[small] In a colony this small, every request is overheard, and {PAWN_nameDef} knows it.
[large] {PAWN_nameDef} has to wait in line behind two other complaints, but gets there.
[poor] The colony is scraping by, and {PAWN_nameDef} looks ashamed to be asking at all.
[rich] With the storerooms full, {PAWN_nameDef} sees no reason not to ask.
[tribal|medieval] At the fire that evening, {PAWN_nameDef} speaks before the elders can.
[forother] {PAWN_nameDef} glances over at {FOR_nameDef} before speaking, as if checking it's all right.
[forother] {FOR_nameDef} would never ask. {PAWN_nameDef} has decided to do it for {FOR_objective}.
[trigger:raid] The wounded are still being carried in when {PAWN_nameDef} grabs someone's arm.
[trigger:raid] {PAWN_nameDef} hasn't stopped shaking since the fighting ended.
[trigger:raid,lowtech] Arrows still stick out of the walls. {PAWN_nameDef} pulls one free and holds it up as {PAWN_possessive} argument.
[trigger:raid] {PAWN_nameDef} comes to talk with someone else's blood still on {PAWN_possessive} hands.
[trigger:death] The body hasn't been buried yet. {PAWN_nameDef} keeps looking at it, then away, then back.
[trigger:death] The news has gone around the colony twice already. {PAWN_nameDef} hasn't said a word until now.
[trigger:death] {PAWN_nameDef} has been sitting in the same spot since morning, and speaks without looking up.
[trigger:cold] {PAWN_nameDef} spent the night shivering under a blanket that was not up to the job.
[trigger:cold] Frost on the inside of the walls. {PAWN_nameDef} wakes up angry about it.
[trigger:cold] Blue-lipped and stamping {PAWN_possessive} feet, {PAWN_nameDef} has had enough of the cold.
[trigger:heat] {PAWN_nameDef} lay awake half the night in a puddle of {PAWN_possessive} own sweat.
[trigger:heat] The air in the sleeping quarters is like soup. {PAWN_nameDef} emerges red-faced and short-tempered.
[trigger:floor] {PAWN_nameDef} finishes another meal hunched on the floor and gets up brushing crumbs off {PAWN_possessive} knees.
[trigger:floor] Another dinner off the dirt. {PAWN_nameDef} sets the bowl down very deliberately.
[trigger:barracks] {PAWN_nameDef} slept badly again, and can now tell every snorer in the barracks apart by sound.
[trigger:barracks] Woken for the third time by someone's elbow, {PAWN_nameDef} is ready to talk about living arrangements.
[trigger:rawfood] {PAWN_nameDef} is still chewing something raw and unidentifiable when {PAWN_pronoun} speaks.
[trigger:sick] Pale and sweating, {PAWN_nameDef} sits up in bed long enough to make a point.
[trigger:sick] Between bouts of being violently ill, {PAWN_nameDef} has had time to think about the kitchen.
[trigger:dark] {PAWN_nameDef} stubbed a toe on {PAWN_possessive} own bed in the dark last night.
[trigger:naked] Shivering and trying to keep some dignity, {PAWN_nameDef} makes a request.
[trigger:cabin] After days indoors, {PAWN_nameDef} snaps at anyone who speaks to {PAWN_objective}.
[trigger:corpse] The smell drifts in from outside, and {PAWN_nameDef} has had enough of it.
[trigger:envy] {PAWN_nameDef} has been looking at {ENVIED_nameDef}'s new arrangement all morning.
[trigger:envy] {PAWN_nameDef} watched {ENVIED_nameDef} get what {ENVIED_pronoun} asked for, and has been thinking about it ever since.
[trigger:passion] {PAWN_nameDef} hasn't had time for the work {PAWN_pronoun} loves in days, and it shows.
[trigger:injury] {PAWN_nameDef} is still learning to manage without what the injury took.
[trigger:title] Since receiving {PAWN_possessive} title, {PAWN_nameDef} has been looking at the colony with a critical eye.
{PAWN_nameDef} stands in the doorway for a long moment before saying anything.
{PAWN_nameDef} walks around it twice, touches it once, and only then turns around.
{PAWN_nameDef} finds the people who made it happen and thanks them, awkwardly.
It takes {PAWN_nameDef} a while to notice, and then {PAWN_pronoun} tells anyone who'll listen.
[evening|night] {PAWN_nameDef} hums all through supper.
[trait:Abrasive] {PAWN_nameDef} inspects it with narrowed eyes, looking for a flaw, and fails to find one.
[trait:Kind] {PAWN_nameDef} thanks everyone who touched it, by name, including the hauler who just carried the wood.
[trait:Psychopath] {PAWN_nameDef} looks it over, says "Good," and goes back to work.
[promised] The council kept its promise, and {PAWN_nameDef} will remember that.
[petition] Those who signed on to the request crowd around it, talking over one another.
[bitter] {PAWN_nameDef} had stopped expecting anything, and doesn't seem to know what to say.
[child] {PAWN_nameDef} runs to tell everyone, then runs back to make sure it's still there.
[old] {PAWN_nameDef} nods slowly and says, "That'll do."
{PAWN_nameDef} runs a hand over it, as if to check it's real.
{PAWN_nameDef} goes quiet for a moment, then laughs out loud.
{PAWN_nameDef} drags the nearest person over to see it.
{PAWN_nameDef} says thank you three times, each time in a different way.
{PAWN_nameDef} sits down beside it and doesn't get up for a while.
{PAWN_nameDef} looks at it from the doorway, then from the other side, then from the doorway again.
[child] {PAWN_nameDef} shows it to every grown-up in turn and makes each one say it's good.
[old] {PAWN_nameDef} lowers {PAWN_objective}self onto the nearest seat and looks at it for a long time.
I saw what {ENVIED_nameDef} got.
Since we're handing things out now, and {ENVIED_nameDef} got one...
No offense to {ENVIED_nameDef}, but I've been here just as long.
Now that {ENVIED_nameDef} has one, it's hard not to notice I don't.

warm.li: I'm glad for {ENVIED_nameDef}, I really am. It made me realize I'd like one too.
Seeing {ENVIED_nameDef} so happy got me thinking.
{ENVIED_nameDef} deserved it. I'd like one too, when there's time.

blunt.li: So {ENVIED_nameDef} gets one and I don't?
Right. {ENVIED_nameDef} asked, {ENVIED_nameDef} got. My turn.
What's {ENVIED_nameDef} done to earn it that I haven't?
{ENVIED_nameDef} got one. I want one.

cheerful.li: Seeing {ENVIED_nameDef}'s gave me an idea!
I saw {ENVIED_nameDef}'s and now I want one too!
{ENVIED_nameDef} let me try it, and now I want one too!

gloomy.li: {ENVIED_nameDef} got one. Of course.
Some people only have to ask once.
Of course {ENVIED_nameDef} got one first.

cold.li: {ENVIED_nameDef} set a precedent. I'm invoking it.
Fair is fair. {ENVIED_nameDef} received one; so should I.
{ENVIED_nameDef} has set a precedent. I'm invoking it.

plain.li: I'll hold you to that.
A promise, then. Good. I'll stop asking.
Right. I'll believe it when I see it.

warm.li: Thank you. Take the time you need.
That's all I wanted to hear.

blunt.li: Promised. Remember you said that.
Fine. Don't make me bring it up again.

cheerful.li: A promise! I'm going to count the days.
Thank you! You won't regret it.

gloomy.li: People promise things all the time out here. We'll see.
[bitter] I've heard that before.
Thanks. I won't get my hopes up.

cold.li: Noted. I will check on progress.
An agreement, then. I'll be watching to see if it's kept.

plain.li: No? Well. At least you said so.
I suppose there are bigger problems right now.
[trusting] I understand. I don't like it, but I understand.
[poor] I know we're stretched thin. Doesn't make it easier.
[afterraid] Right. Walls first. I get it.

warm.li: That's all right. I'd rather know than wonder.
Thank you for being honest with me.

blunt.li: Fine. Remember this next time you need something hauled.
Great. Just great.
[bitter] You didn't even think about it, did you?

cheerful.li: Oh well, can't win them all! I'll ask again another day.
No? That's all right! I'll think of something else to ask for.

gloomy.li: Of course not.
I don't know why I asked.
[bitter] Right on schedule.

cold.li: Understood. I will adjust my expectations accordingly.
Your decision. I'll remember it.

plain.li: Not to nag, but "{WISH}" is still waiting.
Has anyone had a chance to think about "{WISH}"?
I'm still hoping for "{WISH}", in case it slipped anyone's mind.
[promised] You did promise. I haven't forgotten, even if you have.
[winter] It's a long winter, and I'm still waiting on "{WISH}".
[night] I was lying awake thinking about "{WISH}" again.
[petition] There are several of us still waiting on "{WISH}".
I keep meaning to ask again about "{WISH}", so here I am.
Any news on "{WISH}"?
"{WISH}" hasn't happened yet. I'm only mentioning it.
[promised] I'm holding you to that promise about "{WISH}".
[winter] Winter's dragging on, and so is "{WISH}".
[petition] We're still waiting on "{WISH}", the lot of us, and we talk about it at supper.

warm.li: No rush. But if there's ever a spare day, "{WISH}" would mean a lot to me.
I don't want to be a bother. I'm just still hoping, that's all.
I know there's a lot to do. "{WISH}" is still on my mind, though.
Whenever someone has a moment, I'd still love "{WISH}".

blunt.li: {WISH}. Still waiting.
I asked days ago. Anyone?
I'm asking about "{WISH}" again. Did anyone hear me the first time?
"{WISH}". Any day now.
Still nothing on "{WISH}". Why?

cheerful.li: Just a friendly reminder about "{WISH}"!
Still waiting on "{WISH}", and still in a good mood about it.
Me again! Still dreaming about "{WISH}".
Just checking in on "{WISH}". I'm still hopeful!

gloomy.li: I suppose "{WISH}" isn't going to happen. I'll stop mentioning it.
There's always something more important than "{WISH}".
Still no "{WISH}". I'm not surprised.
Not a word about "{WISH}" in days. I can take a hint.

cold.li: I'd like to know where things stand on "{WISH}".
I note that "{WISH}" is still outstanding.
"{WISH}" remains unaddressed. I'm keeping count of the days.
I asked for "{WISH}" some time ago, and I expect an answer.

plain.li: I won't ask about "{WISH}" again.
I've asked about "{WISH}" for long enough. After this, I'm done.
[promised] You promised me "{WISH}". Time's nearly up on that promise.
[petition] There are a few of us waiting on "{WISH}" now, and we've started talking among ourselves.
This is the last time I'll raise "{WISH}". After this I'll stop hoping.
If "{WISH}" doesn't happen soon, I'll take that as my answer.
I've waited a long time for "{WISH}", and my patience is nearly gone.
[promised] A promise is a promise. "{WISH}", please, before it's too late.
[petition] We've all asked for "{WISH}", and we'd like an answer before the week is out.

warm.li: I've been patient about "{WISH}". I'm trying to stay patient.
I've tried not to make a fuss, but "{WISH}" matters to me.
I hate to push, but "{WISH}" means a lot to me, and time's running out.
Please don't forget "{WISH}". It's the only thing I've asked for.

blunt.li: {WISH}. Now, or forget I ever asked.
I'm done being polite about "{WISH}".
You've got a few days. Then I stop caring what you think of me.
Last chance on "{WISH}". Then I'm done asking.
"{WISH}". Yes or no. Soon.

cheerful.li: I'm still smiling, but I'm getting upset about "{WISH}"!
Even my good mood has limits, and "{WISH}" is finding them.
Still smiling, barely! Please, "{WISH}", before I lose it.
I've been patient and cheerful about "{WISH}", and I'm running low on both!

gloomy.li: I'll just keep waiting, then. It's what I'm good at.
I seem to be the only one who cares about "{WISH}".
I knew "{WISH}" would come to nothing. I'm just saying it out loud now.
After this I won't ask about "{WISH}" again. There's no point.

cold.li: This is my final request about "{WISH}". I'll draw my own conclusions afterward.
You are running out of time to address "{WISH}".
I've been patient about "{WISH}". That patience ends soon.
Consider this the last reminder about "{WISH}". After it, I'll act as I see fit.

plain.li: If you want something done around here, apparently you do it yourself.
I waited long enough, so I did it myself.
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] I'd rather work than wait. It's done.

warm.li: I didn't want to bother anyone. I hope that's all right.
I figured everyone was busy, so I took care of it.

blunt.li: Did it myself. You're welcome.
Next time I ask for something, maybe just say yes. Saves time.

cheerful.li: I took care of it myself! Only one bent nail.
Look at me, solving problems!

gloomy.li: On my own, like always.
Doesn't feel as good when you have to do it yourself.

cold.li: The request was not addressed. I addressed it.
Waiting was costing me more than the work.

plain.li: I asked for "{MINE}" first.
So {OTHER_nameDef} gets to skip the line. Good to know.
Some requests get answered fast, I see.

warm.li: Good for {OTHER_nameDef}, really. I can wait a bit longer.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} asked after me and got it first.
I was first in line, with "{MINE}". Remember?

cheerful.li: Happy for {OTHER_nameDef}! I'm sure my turn is next.

gloomy.li: Someone's always ahead of me.
Of course it's {OTHER_nameDef}.

cold.li: Interesting order of priorities.

plain.li: You promised. You actually promised.
I stopped asking because you gave me your word. That's on me, I suppose.
Remember this the next time you ask me to trust you.

warm.li: I believed you, that's all. I really did.

blunt.li: Don't bother promising me anything else.
Never again.

cheerful.li: Well, you fooled me! I'll know better next time.

gloomy.li: I knew better, and I believed you anyway.

cold.li: A promise was made and not kept. I have updated my assessment of you.

plain.li: Ask the council? Might as well ask the rocks.
Don't bother asking for anything. I've tried.
They'll listen to you right up until you need something.
[winter] It's a long winter, and the council doesn't hear a word I say.
[afterraid] I held the wall yesterday, and I still can't get a straight answer out of the council.

blunt.li: I'm not asking for anything ever again.
The council is a lot of talk from people who never haul anything.

gloomy.li: I used to think it mattered what I wanted.
I've stopped expecting anyone here to care.

cold.li: This colony's leadership has consistently failed to meet my requests. I've noted each instance.

cheerful.li: I've stopped asking the council for things! It saves so much time.

warm.li: I try not to take it personally. It's getting harder.
